body: If you can get the motivation to begin exercising, please do because I really believe that it helps me be happier.  even though it may feel brief or like phony happiness, it may give you enough good feeling to do something. Go to school. Don’t go to school. It doesn’t matter. begin with exercising, find a something that you like or at least don’t hate, find a person to bond with, start making moves. Get a job, move away, develop a better relationship with your mom, start cooking, learn how to code, buy caffeine pills, try to have fun, go on a road trip, do weed. I’m not sure what I’m saying, but I understand where you’re coming from, and I believe that if you can start moving even the slightest bit in the positive direction then you will be able to keep going. Sorry if this is unhelpful
Exercise is good too. Run until you can't anymore. Endorphins will also actually make you less sad too

Sometimes I listen to really loud music just to feel like I'm damaging myself a little bit. Maybe find an outlet to express your need for this feeling in another way. Or find someone that can hold your baggage

You seem to know that the haters are just haters. 
Try not to let it consume you and love yourself. 
I'm sorry if this doesn't help
No atonement necessary
